breaking.member: Button and choice widget CSS boxes
breaking.change: Button bases and checkbox, switch and radio parts have persistent layout and paint boxes separate from their semantic hosts. Host and part transforms compose instead of overwriting each other.
breaking.fix: Style the visual box with ::part(base), ::part(box), ::part(track) or the registered part name. Keep host dimensions, events and accessibility on the host. Host color and font size inherit into labels.

fixed.summary: New parts measure before entering the layout cache. Retained content preserves logical IDs while attaching under its physical part box. Settled animations reuse paint, and removing and reinserting a host retires its parts.
